methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Cabinet secretary: Southside county loses two economic development prospects due to uncertainty over data center taxes
signals.signal_reading: Policy uncertainty blocking data center investment in historically underserved Greensville County reinforces infrastructure concentration in NoVA while preventing even shallow economic participation in Virginia's rural regions—deepening capability and opportunity gaps.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Young workforce facing AI pressure in Richmond signals concentrated skill demands in metro hubs without distributed upskilling infrastructure, creating metro-centric talent gravity while potentially displacing workers without deep technical capability.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training through Virginia Tech represents distributed, peer-based capability building in Appalachian Virginia—exactly the institutional mechanism needed to spread deep AI fluency beyond metro concentration zones.

signals.title: Norfolk Southern deploys AI system to catch wheel defects before they break - The Business Journals
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Southern deploying proprietary AI for industrial defect detection demonstrates deep technical application concentrated in established corporate infrastructure, signaling capability clustering in metro/defense corridors rather than distributed adoption patterns.

signals.title: U.Va. pilots three new artificial intelligence literacy courses - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: UVA piloting AI literacy courses institution-wide creates potential distribution mechanism for foundational capability across Virginia's higher education network, but depth depends on whether curriculum builds critical technical skills or merely surface-level platform familiarity.
